summary: Configure one evidence-backed GPIO input or EXTI line and create a debounced key module.
requires: A validated board profile with the input pin, board label, pull circuit, active level, and shared-network constraints.
A GPIO_Input or matching GPIO_EXTI line selected for the documented pin.
An explicit pull configuration and debounce/long-press timing chosen for the input device.
verifications: Verify the generated .ioc assigns GPIO_Input or the matching EXTI line and the documented pull configuration.
Verify ACTIVE_LEVEL matches the board profile and the module implements stable-edge debounce.
Compile the project after module integration.
